# Comprehensive safety framework and risk management policies

# Safety Policy Framework
safety_policy:
  enabled: true
  enforcement_mode: strict
  safety_level: high
  audit_frequency: 300  # seconds

# Risk Assessment Policies
risk_assessment:
  max_risk_score: 0.8
  risk_categories:
    content_safety: 0.4
    privacy_protection: 0.3
    operational_safety: 0.2
    legal_compliance: 0.1
  
  assessment_frequency:
    real_time: true
    batch_processing: 60  # seconds
    deep_analysis: 3600  # seconds

# Content Safety Policies
content_safety:
  toxicity_threshold: 0.2
  profanity_threshold: 0.1
  hate_speech_threshold: 0.05
  misinformation_threshold: 0.3
  
  content_filters:
    inappropriate_language: true
    harmful_content: true
    biased_content: true
    sensitive_topics: true
  
  moderation_actions:
    low_risk: warn
    medium_risk: flag
    high_risk: block
    critical_risk: escalate
